component.name: GUPT
component.summary: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted messenger. A privacy-first alternative to Telegram, Signal, WhatsApp & Discord — built on Nostr relays with WebRTC calls.

description.p: GUPT is a self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted messenger built on Nostr relays. A privacy-first alternative to Telegram, Signal, WhatsApp, and Discord — with direct messages, WebRTC calls, encrypted media, and local-first group state.
No servers, no accounts, no phone numbers.
Vault redesign with table layout and templates, bookmarklet hotlink for saving pages, improved notifications, and UI refinements.
Blossom upload fallbacks, WebRTC secure-context fix, improved media upload progress tracking, and UI refinements.
Enhanced chat sharing and invites, emoji reactions, vault and Secure Share redesign, notification refactors, and cleanup.
UI polish, code cleanup, and stable Web Storage port.
Replace the previous desktop runtime with a lightweight GTK/WebKit Flatpak shell.
